slides.narration: Chapter 24: The Energy Budget. The universe is 68 percent dark energy, 27 percent dark matter, and 5 percent ordinary matter. In the framework, these fractions are not free parameters — they are derived from the Drishti bound.

The dark matter fraction equals D squared — the Drishti bound squared — about 26.5 percent. The observation limit itself becomes the dark matter fraction. The universe hides from itself exactly the amount that the screening structure predicts.
